<h4>Sorrento Kite Village Lesson Packages 2024/25</h4>

<p>All Packages Include Everything &ndash; BUT &ndash; Swim-Wear and Sunglasses (Bring Cheap Pair In-case you lose)</p>
<p>Notice: All Training time pictures &amp; videos we take are yours Free&#8230; so you can edit, post and tag us</p>
<p>If you&rsquo;re Serious&#8230;! Just Commit to a 5 Hour package and see how far you can go.</p>

<h4>Membership</h4>
</div></div><div  class="tatsu-module tatsu-inline-text clearfix tatsu-H1Xu79IQMa   " ><style></style><div class="tatsu-inline-text-inner tatsu-align-center">

<p>KITE MEMBERSHIP INCLUDES:</p>
<ul>
<li>Kite pump compressor</li>

<li>Secure overnight drying area</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Cost not applicable to Sorrento Beach Club residents.</em></p>
